name: Platform sole
summary: A sole that is raised under the whole foot by layers of cork, wood or foam, and that is covered in leather or cloth.
how: Build the sole in layers of cork, wood or foam, 5 to 10 cm thick.
Cover the edge of the layers in leather, cloth or vinyl.
Fit a wide heel that sits 2 to 4 cm higher than the platform.

origin.note: Salvatore Ferragamo makes wedge soles of cork when leather is scarce.

adoptions.via: Glam rock musicians and makers raise the platform to 10 cm and cover it in bright colours.
